bukhari_1.arabic: إنما الأعمال بالنيات، وإنما لكل امرئ ما نوى
bukhari_1.english: Actions are but by intention, and every person will have only what they intended.
bukhari_1.luganda: Ebikolwa birina okukolebwa olw'ekibiina, era buli muntu alina ky'akola olw'ekibiina kye.

bukhari_2.arabic: من حسن إسلام المرء تركه ما لا يعنيه
bukhari_2.english: Part of a person's good Islam is leaving that which does not concern them.
bukhari_2.luganda: Ekimu ku bulungi bw'Obusiraamu bw'omuntu kwe kuleka ebyo ebitali bya kye.

muslim_1.arabic: المؤمن القوي خير وأحب إلى الله من المؤمن الضعيف
muslim_1.english: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, while there is good in both.
muslim_1.luganda: Omukkiriza omuyinza mulungi era ayagibwa Allah okusinga omukkiriza omunafu, naye mu bombi mulimu obulungi.

bukhari_3.arabic: المسلم من سلم المسلمون من لسانه ويده
bukhari_3.english: A Muslim is one from whose tongue and hand other Muslims are safe.
bukhari_3.luganda: Omusiraamu ye oyo aba abalala aba Siraamu tebasobola kubona kubi ku lulimi lwe wala mu mukono gwe.
